features.name: mask_iou
features.definition: intersection(target,hazard) / union(target,hazard)

features.name: target_overlap_fraction
features.definition: intersection(target,hazard) / area(target)

features.name: hazard_overlap_fraction
features.definition: intersection(target,hazard) / area(hazard)

features.name: target_boundary_within_r1_fraction
features.definition: fraction of target-boundary pixels with distance to hazard boundary <= r1 * image diagonal

features.name: hazard_boundary_within_r1_fraction
features.definition: fraction of hazard-boundary pixels with distance to target boundary <= r1 * image diagonal

features.name: target_boundary_within_r2_fraction
features.definition: fraction of target-boundary pixels with distance to hazard boundary <= r2 * image diagonal

features.name: hazard_boundary_within_r2_fraction
features.definition: fraction of hazard-boundary pixels with distance to target boundary <= r2 * image diagonal

features.name: minimum_boundary_distance_norm
features.definition: minimum Euclidean target-hazard boundary distance divided by image diagonal

features.name: target_to_hazard_boundary_q10_norm
features.definition: 10th percentile target-boundary distance to hazard boundary divided by image diagonal

features.name: hazard_to_target_boundary_q10_norm
features.definition: 10th percentile hazard-boundary distance to target boundary divided by image diagonal

features.name: target_lower50_overlap_fraction
features.definition: hazard overlap fraction inside the lower 50 percent of the independent target-mask bounding box

features.name: target_lower25_overlap_fraction
features.definition: hazard overlap fraction inside the lower 25 percent of the independent target-mask bounding box

features.name: target_lower50_boundary_within_r1_fraction
features.definition: fraction of lower-50-percent target-boundary pixels whose hazard-boundary distance is <= r1

features.name: target_lower50_boundary_within_r2_fraction
features.definition: fraction of lower-50-percent target-boundary pixels whose hazard-boundary distance is <= r2

features.name: apparent_boundary_x_coverage
features.definition: fraction of target-support columns containing an observable water or river apparent upper boundary

features.name: apparent_boundary_slope_sin
features.definition: sine of the fitted apparent water-boundary angle

features.name: apparent_boundary_slope_cos
features.definition: cosine of the fitted apparent water-boundary angle

features.name: target_bottom_offset_from_apparent_boundary_norm
features.definition: median target-bottom minus apparent water-boundary vertical coordinate divided by image diagonal

features.name: apparent_boundary_valid
features.definition: 1 when a local apparent water or river boundary can be computed, otherwise 0

features.name: pair_truncated
features.definition: 1 when either independent mask reaches the image border within one pixel

features.name: fibe_pair_valid
features.definition: 1 only for a supported canonical target-hazard pair with valid independent masks
